Both integrate limitations, although those limitations interrupt the final practical sequence."}],"transfer_supported":"The drafts transfer a structure of reader, decision, concept, bounded evidence and practical review across subjects. 'If you approve work, that distinction matters more' is an authorial judgment, not a study result. Checking is not asserted to cause the slowdown.","useful_decision":"Compare total time to approved, usable work with and without AI, including instruction, checking, correction and approver time.","voice":"Concrete opening and memorable closing sustain the literal telling. 'It is not yet a time saving' could be read too categorically; the supported point is that faster output alone does not establish a saving.","editing_burden":"Light: qualify that time-saving sentence, explicitly include production time and comparable tasks, and verify the additional study counts."}},"evidence_integrity":{"security":"Both incident chains remain attributed and separate. The proposed safeguards align with the supplied CERT-In recommendations, but those recommendations are not measured effectiveness evidence.","ai":"The frozen source material supports the 5,172-agent population, publisher-summary 15% finding, METR 19% finding and unreliable-current-estimate boundary. The additional participant and task counts are not shown in the supplied source excerpts. Both AI drafts avoid treating the studies as equivalent settings or explaining the slowdown solely through checking.","publication_check":"The drafts name their sources but do not include source links. The supplied URLs can support reader verification if the publication format permits."},"conclusion":"The reframed security drafts more consistently serve non-specialist approvers while retaining the central access-versus-permission distinction. Across security and AI, the practical review structure transfers with different evidence and telling. Production-method attribution remains unresolved because engine and direct-control labels were not supplied; no winner or human preference follows from this audit."}
